# Core Rule 12 - You can do almost anything you want to insurgents
Insurgents are dangerous and deadly criminals.
Anyone can do anything they want to insurgents with the exception of violating core rules (ERP ect.)
Insurgents can fight back against you.
Insurgents may not kill people without reason.
You can tell if someone is an insurgent because they will have a disabled bomb-collar in their neck slot.
